title: 240° on the unit circle
caption: The point at 240° is in the third quadrant, 60° past the negative x-axis. Its coordinates are (cos 240°, sin 240°) = (−½, −√3/2), so tan 240° = sin/cos = √3.
alt: The unit circle with the point at 240° in the third quadrant at (−0.5, −0.866), its reference angle of 60° marked at the centre, and dashed lines to the axes.
description: Turn 240° anticlockwise from the positive x-axis: the point is in the third quadrant.
It is 60° past the negative x-axis, so the reference angle is 60°.
Its y-coordinate is sin 240° = −sin 60° = −√3/2, so tan 240° = (−√3/2)/(−½) = √3.
